summary: Expose verified fleet membership and durable leave confirmation to local adapters

schema.detail: The claim schema is unchanged; leave receipts are local worker state.

rules.detail: Verified membership remains authoritative. Read-only adapter requests do not extend leave grace or admit ended members to ordinary replication.

compatibility.detail: The trusted local API supports fleet membership reads and a read-only leave-state snapshot. Authenticated leave receipts distinguish confirmed departures from unconfirmed departures with a bounded 120-second carrier grace.

downtime.detail: Restart the daemon and replication worker to expose leave-state snapshots.

recovery.detail: Durable receiver observations preserve grace deadlines across worker restarts. Missing worker authority or persistence failures fail closed rather than manufacturing confirmation.
